label: Bible Study
prompt: Call unto me, and I will _____ thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
note: Sometimes nicknamed 'God's phone number' — call, and he answers with great and mighty things.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He hath made every thing _____ in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
verse: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
note: Every thing beautiful 'in his time' — God's schedule runs on beauty, not on hurry.

label: Sunday School
prompt: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery _____, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
verse: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
note: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego's confidence: 'burning fiery furnace' — the KJV doubles down on the heat.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in _____ shall be your strength: and ye would not.
verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
note: God's rescue plan was rest and quiet trust; Judah preferred fast horses. Note the ending: 'and ye would not.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of _____. For without the law sin was dead.
verse: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
note: 'Concupiscence' — runaway desire, and possibly the hardest word to pronounce in the whole KJV.
